description: Fetch Wikipedia's current news (news动态 / In the news) for a language edition. Returns recent major events linked to their Wikipedia articles. Supports zh/en/ja/ko/fr/de/es/ru and more; unmapped languages return EMPTY_RESULT.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of news items to return (1-100).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Wikipedia language edition code (default zh). Examples: zh, en, ja, ko, fr, de, es, ru.
